Comment.doc:
A discussion entry on an issue. `id`, `issue_id`, `created_at` are
immutable; `body` and `edited_at` are LWW registers. The author is the
entry's owner stamp, and only they may edit or delete it - on every node.
`thread` is one issue's comments, oldest first.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: `comment-<ms>-<8 hex>`.

fields.name: issue_id
fields.doc: The issue this comment is on.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The comment text; never empty.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Unix milliseconds.

fields.name: edited_at
fields.doc: Unix milliseconds of the last edit, or None.

Issue.doc:
An issue's shared triage state. Every field is a `LwwRegister` so concurrent
edits converge last-writer-wins. Labels live in a separate index (see
`IssueTracker`).

fields.name: summary
fields.doc: What is wrong, in a sentence or two.

fields.name: impact
fields.doc: Who or what it affects and how badly.

fields.name: repro
fields.doc: Steps, logs or conditions that trigger it.

fields.name: resolution_criteria
fields.doc: What "fixed" must satisfy.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: One of Open, In progress, Blocked, Done.

fields.name: priority
fields.doc: One of low, medium, high, urgent.

fields.name: assignee
fields.doc: Free text; None when unassigned.

IssueHeader.doc:
Who filed an issue, and what they called it. Set once at creation. The filer
is the entry's owner stamp, not a field, so nobody can re-attribute an issue.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: 1 to 64 characters.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Unix milliseconds.

IssueTracker.doc: One repository's issue board: its issues, comments, labels and URL.

fields.name: headers
fields.doc:
Issue id → header, owned by whoever filed it. An issue exists while its
header does.

fields.name: issues
fields.doc: Issue id → triage state. Shared - any teammate may triage.

fields.name: comments
fields.doc:
All comments across all issues, keyed by generated id, each owned by
its author.

fields.name: labels
fields.doc:
Key `"{issue_id}\u{1}{label}"` → the label. Concurrent adds of the same
label collapse to one entry (no duplicates); removal is a conflict-free
key delete.

fields.name: repo_url
fields.doc:
The GitHub repository URL this context (repo) tracks. Empty until set;
LWW so concurrent edits from teammates converge last-writer-wins.

fields.name: issue_id
fields.doc: The labelled issue.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: 1 to 64 characters.

fields.name: added_at
fields.doc: Unix milliseconds of the latest add.
